---
title: "Usage"
description: "Every Storywell command and flag, with examples."
---

The general shape is `storywell <command> [options]`. Most commands take a `--source` (default
`audible`) and the options that source needs. Run `storywell --help` or `storywell <command> --help`
at any time.

## Commands

### `sources`

List the vendors Storywell can read from.

```sh
storywell sources
```

### `list`

List the finished books a source reports — no StoryGraph involved. Use it to sanity-check a source
and tune `--threshold` before syncing.

```sh
storywell list                          # default source: audible
storywell list --source audible -t 0.9  # lower the "finished" cutoff
storywell list --source goodreads --file goodreads_library_export.csv
```

### `sync`

Match a source's finished books to StoryGraph and mark them **read**, then (by default) sync your
rating and review too.

```sh
storywell sync --dry-run                # preview the match plan, write nothing
storywell sync                          # mark finished books as read
storywell sync --limit 20               # process at most 20 books
storywell sync --no-ratings             # read status only, skip ratings/reviews
storywell sync --headed                 # watch the browser work (debugging)
```

High-confidence matches are written directly; ambiguous ones prompt you to pick a candidate or
skip. Sync is **idempotent** — matches are keyed by `source:id`, so vendors never collide and a
book is only re-written if its finish date changed. Progress is saved even if a run is interrupted
partway through.

Because an audiobook source marks the **audiobook edition**, after matching a book Storywell
resolves that work's audio edition and marks _that_ read; if a work has no audio edition it falls
back to the best-matching edition rather than skipping. Non-audio sources tag the best-matching
edition directly.

### `collections`

Mark the books _contained in_ a finished collection (e.g. an Audible series bundle) as read. Because
vendors don't expose a collection's contents directly, Storywell proposes titles parsed from the
StoryGraph entry's description and lets you confirm.

```sh
storywell collections                   # dry-run (default): preview detected collections
storywell collections --no-dry-run      # prompt to pick which contained titles to mark read
```

### `retag`

A read-only report: for books already synced, which are sitting on a **non-audio** StoryGraph
edition that has an audio edition available to move to. It sizes a back-fill — applying the moves is
not implemented yet.

```sh
storywell retag
storywell retag --limit 50
```

### `storygraph-login` / `storygraph-status`

Log in to StoryGraph once (saves the session) and check whether the saved session is still valid.

```sh
storywell storygraph-login
storywell storygraph-status
```

## Flag reference

| Flag | Applies to | Default | Meaning |
|------|-----------|---------|---------|
| `--source`, `-s` | all read commands | `audible` | Which vendor to read from. |
| `--threshold`, `-t` | all read commands | `0.95` | Treat a book as finished when `percent_complete ≥ threshold` (plus anything the source flags complete). |
| `--auth-file` | audible | auto | Path to the `audible-cli` auth JSON. Auto-discovered if omitted. |
| `--profile` | audible | primary | `audible-cli` profile name. |
| `--file`, `-f` | goodreads, librarything, kobo | — | Path to the export CSV / SQLite database. |
| `--token` | hardcover | `$HARDCOVER_TOKEN` | Hardcover personal API token. |
| `--as-read` | librarything | off | Treat every catalogued book as read (it's a catalogue, not a read tracker). |
| `--read-date` | librarything | off | Stamp today's date as the finish date for `--as-read` books with no Date Read. |
| `--collection` | librarything | all | Only import books in this collection (repeatable; omit for all). |
| `--dry-run` / `--no-dry-run` | sync, collections | see below | Preview without writing. `sync` defaults to writing; `collections` defaults to dry-run. |
| `--limit` | sync, retag | `0` (all) | Process at most N books. |
| `--ratings` / `--no-ratings` | sync | on | Also sync your rating + review (with a narrator note). |
| `--headless` / `--headed` | sync, collections, retag | headless | Run the browser hidden, or `--headed` to watch/debug. |
| `--version` | root | — | Print version and exit. |
